speed.label: Move speed
speed.help: Top speed in metres per second. The same in all 8 directions: diagonals are not faster.

accel.label: Start-up grip
accel.help: How fast you reach full speed. 80 = full speed in about 6 frames. Low feels like ice.

brake.label: Stopping grip
brake.help: How fast you stop when you let go. Higher than start-up, so you stop exactly where you mean to.

hurtRadius.label: Hurt radius
hurtRadius.help: How close something must get to hurt you, in metres. The robot LOOKS 0.5 wide: keeping this smaller forgives near misses.

fireRate.label: Shots per second
fireRate.help: While the fire button is held.

speed.label: Shot speed
speed.help: Metres per second. Fast enough that you rarely need to lead a target.

range.label: Shot range
range.help: How far a shot flies before it fades, in metres.

damage.label: Damage per shot
damage.help: A creeper has 2 health, a spitter 3, a ram 6 (see KINDS in enemies.js).

hitRadius.label: Hit radius (forgiving)
hitRadius.help: A shot hits anything this close to its path. The drop you SEE is much smaller: that gap is what makes shooting feel generous.

size.label: Shot size (looks only)
size.help: How big the drop is drawn. Does not change what it hits.

assist.label: Aim magnetism
assist.help: How much a shot bends toward the enemy nearest your aim line. 0 = none, 1 = snaps onto it.

assistAngle.label: Magnetism cone (degrees)
assistAngle.help: Only enemies within this angle of where you aim attract shots.

minConverge.label: Nearest crossing point (m)
minConverge.help: Shots leave the hose (off to one side) and cross your aim line at the aim point. Closer aim points than this are pushed out, so shots never fly sideways.

spread.label: Spread (degrees)
spread.help: A little randomness per shot, so a stream looks alive. Keep it small.

flashTime.label: Muzzle flash (s)
flashTime.help: How long the flash at the hose shows for each shot.

pitchVary.label: Shot sound variety
pitchVary.help: Random pitch change per shot, in semitones. Without it, fast fire sounds like a machine.

stickReach.label: Gamepad aim reach (m)
stickReach.help: With a stick there is no cursor, so shots cross your aim line this far out.

distance.label: Dash distance (m)
distance.help: Short on purpose: a dodge, not a way to travel.

time.label: Dash time (s)
time.help: How long the dash takes. Shorter = snappier.

invuln.label: Safe time (s)
invuln.help: Nothing can hurt you for this long from the start of a dash. A little longer than the dash itself, to forgive late presses.

cooldown.label: Cooldown (s)
cooldown.help: Wait between dashes. The disc at your feet shows it filling.

buffer.label: Press-early window (s)
buffer.help: A dash pressed this long before it is ready still happens.

trail.label: Afterimage fade (s)
trail.help: How long the ghost copies left by a dash take to fade.

speed.label: Enemy speed x
speed.help: Multiplies every enemy's walking speed (each kind's own speed is in KINDS in enemies.js).

telegraph.label: Warning time x
telegraph.help: Multiplies how long every enemy warns before it strikes. Raise it to make the game kinder.

shotSpeed.label: Seed speed x
shotSpeed.help: Multiplies the speed of enemy seeds. They are slow so you can walk around them.

spawnWarn.label: Spawn warning (s)
spawnWarn.help: A ring closes on the ground for this long before an enemy appears.

safeSpawn.label: No spawns within (m)
safeSpawn.help: Nothing ever appears closer to you than this.

maxAttackers.label: Attackers at once
maxAttackers.help: How many enemies may be winding up or striking at the same moment. The rest wait their turn.

separation.label: Push apart
separation.help: How firmly overlapping enemies push each other apart. 0 = they stack into one blob.

spacing.label: Personal space x
spacing.help: How much room each enemy keeps, as a multiple of its size.

breakTime.label: Breather between waves (s)
breakTime.help: A moment to collect gems and breathe. The waves themselves are the table in waves.js.

knockback.label: Knock-back on hit
knockback.help: How hard a shot shoves an enemy (heavy kinds resist: see knock in KINDS).

killStopMs.label: Freeze on a kill (ms)
killStopMs.help: A tiny freeze when an enemy pops. 30 ms is two frames: felt, not seen.

bossStopMs.label: Freeze on the boss kill (ms)
bossStopMs.help: A longer freeze for the big moment.

hurtStopMs.label: Freeze when hurt (ms)
hurtStopMs.help: So you always notice losing a heart.

hurtShake.label: Shake when hurt
hurtShake.help: Camera shake in metres. Shake is saved for big events: being hurt, and the boss.

bigShake.label: Shake on the boss kill
bigShake.help: The biggest shake in the game.

hurtInvuln.label: Safe time after a hit (s)
hurtInvuln.help: You blink and nothing can hurt you again for this long.

hurtKnock.label: Push when hurt
hurtKnock.help: How hard you are shoved away from what hit you.

lastHeartSlow.label: Last-heart slow motion
lastHeartSlow.help: When you drop to one heart the world runs at this speed for a moment. 1 = off.

invincible.label: Invincible
invincible.help: Nothing costs hearts. For testing and for looking around.

height.label: Height
height.help: How high the camera is above the player, in metres.

back.label: Back
back.help: How far behind (toward the bottom of the screen). 0 = straight down; same as Height = 45 degrees.

fov.label: Field of view
fov.help: Narrow (30-45) looks flatter and tidier from above.

follow.label: Follow speed
follow.help: Higher = the camera sticks closer to the player. Lower = softer.

lookAhead.label: Look-ahead
lookAhead.help: The camera leans this share of the way toward where you aim.

leash.label: Leash (m)
leash.help: The camera's centre is never further than this from the player, so they can't leave the screen.

crowdZoom.label: Crowd zoom-out
crowdZoom.help: How much further back the camera goes when many enemies are near. 0.14 = 14%.

crowdSize.label: Crowd size
crowdSize.help: This many enemies nearby gives the full zoom-out.

crowdRange.label: Crowd range (m)
crowdRange.help: Enemies within this distance count as near.

magnetRadius.label: Magnet radius (m)
magnetRadius.help: Gems and hearts this close fly to you.

magnetSpeed.label: Magnet speed
magnetSpeed.help: How fast they start flying in (they speed up on the way).

life.label: Gem lifetime (s)
life.help: Gems blink for the last 3 seconds, then vanish. Hearts last twice as long.

gemScore.label: Points per gem
gemScore.help: Added to the score for each gem.

heartChance.label: Heart drop chance
heartChance.help: Chance a beaten enemy drops a heart, only while you are hurt. A cleared wave always gives one if you are hurt.

streakTime.label: Chime streak window (s)
streakTime.help: Pickups this close together ring higher and higher.
